description:
♛ Top Host
▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔
Welcome to this bold, bohemian home just beyond the heart of downtown Nashville. This stunning haven provides the best of both worlds - close proximity to all the action that Nashville offers! You are just steps away from 8th Avenue South, a bustling area with Publix, Hattie B's, and plenty of bars and restaurants to keep yourself entertained. You can even take a short 15 minute walk to 12 South - one of the most popular Nashville neighborhoods!

The space
▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

THIS HOME IS PERFECT FOR . . .

✓ Family Getaways – Spacious, kid-friendly, and secure.

✓ Bachelorette & Bachelor Parties – Stylish home near nightlife.

✓ Concert & Event Travelers – Convenient location for top venues.

✓ Corporate & Business Stays – Fast WiFi, dedicated workspace.

✓ Friend Reunions – Ample common areas and sleeping arrangements.

✓ And More! – Versatile space suitable for various travelers.

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

▌LIVING & DINING

⊙ Bright, eclectic living area perfect for socializing or relaxing, featuring unique bohemian decor.

⊙ Fully stocked, polka-dotted kitchen equipped with modern appliances, perfect for preparing meals to enjoy at the spacious dining table.

▌BEDROOMS

⊙ Bedroom 3 – 4 Single beds (bunk style), ideal for groups or families.

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

▌BATHROOMS

⊙ Three full bathrooms and one half bath, each stocked with luxury toiletries and stylish fixtures.

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

▌OUTDOOR & COMMUNITY FEATURES

⊙ Private, serene balcony ideal for morning coffees or evening relaxation.

⊙ Two-car private garage parking, free street parking, and secure keypad entry for easy access.

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

▌TOP FOOD & FUN NEARBY

▌REAL GUEST EXPERIENCES
